segments.ja171:1.1: Kalyāṇadhammoti yadā janinda, loke samaññaṃ anupāpuṇāti;
segments.ja171:1.3: Tasmā na hiyyetha [hīyetha (sī.)] naro sapañño, hiriyāpi santo dhuramādiyanti.
segments.ja171:2.1: Sāyaṃ samaññā idha majja pattā, kalyāṇadhammoti janinda loke;
segments.ja171:2.3: Tāhaṃ samekkhaṃ idha pabbajissaṃ, na hi matthi chando idha kāmabhogeti.

lines: Samaññaṃ anupāpuṇātīti yadā sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo pabbajitoti idaṃ paññattivohāraṃ pāpuṇāti.
Tasmā na hiyyethāti tato sāmaññato na parihāyetha.
Hiriyāpi santo dhuramādiyantīti, mahārāja, sappurisā nāma ajjhattasamuṭṭhitāya hiriyā bahiddhasamuṭṭhitena ottappenapi etaṃ pabbajitadhuraṃ gaṇhanti.
Idha majja pattāti idha mayā ajja pattā.
Tāhaṃ samekkhanti taṃ ahaṃ guṇavasena laddhasamaññaṃ samekkhanto passanto.
Na hi matthi chandoti na hi me atthi chando.
